title: DiffHarbor review.json
description: Per-repo settings for DiffHarbor, in the repo root. All keys are optional; unknown keys are ignored.

severity.description: Findings below are dropped before verification; minor drops the nits.

profile.description: What goes inline, the rest folds into the review's summary. quiet: critical and major; chill (default): minor too; assertive: nits too. A PR's "review: <profile>" line or `@bot review <profile>` overrides it.

repoPath.description: A path inside the repo, from its root.

ignore.description: Globs (*, **, ?, [abc], {a,b}); a path without one takes its folder, "!glob" takes paths back in.

tests.description: Run the tests of changed packages. Unset: only when no CI workflow does.

packages.description: Overrides per monorepo part; the longest glob wins.

model_inversion.description: true: switch to another provider's model when the review model's provider's AI wrote at least as many commits as any other AI; commits no AI wrote don't count. A pinned review_model never switches. Default: the server's MODEL_INVERSION, off.

passes.description: Finders per part, each with its second look. The first is review_model's and takes again only; a further one without model takes the provider's second model.

count.description: The classes of files that count. Default ["code"].

skip.description: Globs of files that don't count; "!glob" counts a file whatever its class.

suggest_split.description: The AI suggests splitting a PR from this many changed lines or files, either one is enough. Off by default.

syntax_theme.description: Shiki theme names for the report's code colors.

max.description: The newest learnings of the repo and of the owner a review follows, each. 0 = none. Default 30.

max_age_days.description: Leave out learnings older than this. 0 = any age (default).

learnings.description: What reviews and the chat follow of the saved learnings. Only hides, deletes nothing.

install_scripts.description: Run lifecycle scripts (postinstall, native builds) in the checks' installs. Default false.

base_branches.description: Globs of base branches besides the default branch whose PRs get reviewed without asking.

drafts.description: Draft PRs: manual (default) reviewed on @bot review; opt_in once asked, every later push too; off never.

gitlab_findings.description: GitLab: review posts the findings, answers and summary as one review, one email; discussions each on its own, an email each. Default: the server's GITLAB_FINDINGS.

tickets.description: itsaplan or Linear projects (team keys) a PR may name; unset = any, [] = none.

knowledge.description: Reference docs for the review: a glob of changed files to adapters, 'name' or 'name:ref'. Names only, never URLs or tokens. Unset: off.

knowledge_public.description: true: also read reference docs for a public (or internal) repo. Default off.
